explanation: Behavior is defined as any action that can be observed and described. Although the debate continues over nature (inherited traits) versus nurture (environmental influences), modern scientific consensus indicates that most behaviors possess a genetic foundation. These inherited behaviors are often physically linked to the development and function of the nervous and endocrine systems.

questions.q: What is the scientific definition of behavior as stated in the notes?
opts: Any action that can be observed and described
A purely learned response to environmental stimuli
A physiological change mediated by hormones
An action determined exclusively by conscious choice

opts: They are entirely determined by environmental factors (nurture)
